create.conversations: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversations  (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, model TEXT, user_id TEXT NOT NULL, summary TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
create.message: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, conversation_id TEXT REFERENCES conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, role TEXT, content TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

fetch.messages: SELECT role, content FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at ASC

save.conversation: INSERT INTO conversations (id, user_id) VALUES ($1, $1) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
save.message: INSERT INTO messages (id, conversation_id, role, content) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
